name: Orangeville / Brampton
description: A Highway 10/Hurontario train-feeder corridor, originally numbered 41, with a former midday Bramalea branch.

timeline.event: Former 41 Orangeville was renumbered 37; an additional weekday trip each way was also introduced.
37 mainline serves Brampton GO; midday 37A serves Trinity Common and Bramalea.
All six weekday trips each way in this issue use Brampton GO; the earlier Bramalea branch is absent.
